name: Poisoned Dart Trap (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

disable: DC 23 Thievery check (trained) to disable the pressure plate
reset: The trap resets after 2 rounds. After 5 total attacks, it runs out of poisoned darts.

items.name: Dart Volley
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the pressure plate

---

Effect A poisoned dart shoots at the triggering creature.

items.name: Graveroot
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1d10 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d12 poison damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison damage and Stupefied 2 (1 round)

text: Magical motion sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.
